## CCIPLocalSimulatorFork JS

Hardhat 3 helpers for routing CCIP messages between forked networks: the JavaScript counterpart of the Solidity [`CCIPLocalSimulatorFork`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-simulator-fork). Supports pre-1.6 (`EVM2EVMOnRamp`), 1.6 and CCIP 2.0 (CCV-based) lanes.

[`CCIPLocalSimulatorFork.js`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/scripts/CCIPLocalSimulatorFork.js)

> **NOTE**
>
> Every function takes the `NetworkConnection` returned by `network.connect()` and requires the
> `@nomicfoundation/hardhat-ethers` plugin (it uses `connection.ethers`). TypeScript declarations ship next to the
> script (`CCIPLocalSimulatorFork.d.ts`). Hardhat 2 is not supported; Hardhat 2 users stay on Chainlink Local `0.2.x`.

## Constants

### CCIP_V2_ROUTERS

```javascript
export const CCIP_V2_ROUTERS = Object.freeze({
  11155111: "0x784d49a71BB4C48eB7dA4cD7e6Ecb424f9b5EAB1", // Ethereum Sepolia
  43113: "0x7C9B8B4e8024e5Ee8A630F6FCe9015e470dA5763", // Avalanche Fuji
})
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Dedicated CCIP 2.0 routers deployed next to the default router, keyed by chain ID. Pass them (together with the
> default router) to `routeMessage` so both routers' OffRamps are searched.

## Types

### CCIPSentMessage

Represents a CCIP message sent in a transaction, for any supported protocol version.

| Property            | Type                           | Description                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| era                 | `"PRE_V1_6" \| "V1_6" \| "V2"` | CCIP protocol version of the lane the message was sent on                                                                        |
| onRamp              | `string`                       | Source OnRamp that emitted the message                                                                                           |
| messageId           | `string`                       | The message ID                                                                                                                   |
| sourceChainSelector | `bigint`                       | The source chain selector                                                                                                        |
| destChainSelector   | `bigint`                       | The destination chain selector (`undefined` for pre-1.6)                                                                         |
| message             | `object`                       | Era-specific payload: the pre-1.6 `EVM2EVMMessage`, the 1.6 `EVM2AnyRampMessage`, or for CCIP 2.0 `{ encodedMessage, receipts }` |

## Functions

### getCCIPMessages

Extracts every CCIP message sent in a transaction, for all supported protocol versions.

```javascript
function getCCIPMessages(connection, receipt) => CCIPSentMessage[]
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Parses the pre-1.6 `CCIPSendRequested` and the 1.6 / 2.0 `CCIPMessageSent` events from the receipt logs. For CCIP 2.0,
> the source and destination chain selectors are read from the `MessageV1` wire format without a full decode.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type     | Description                                |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| connection | `object` | Network connection of the source chain     |
| receipt    | `object` | Transaction receipt of the `ccipSend` call |

#### Returns

| Type                | Description                                     |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `CCIPSentMessage[]` | The sent messages, in log order (empty if none) |

### requestLinkFromTheFaucet

Requests LINK tokens from the testnet faucet by impersonating it.

```javascript
async function requestLinkFromTheFaucet(connection, linkAddress, to, amount) => Promise<string>
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type     | Description                                               |
| ----------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| connection  | `object` | Network connection from `network.connect()`               |
| linkAddress | `string` | The address of the LINK contract on the connected network |
| to          | `string` | The address to send LINK to                               |
| amount      | `bigint` | The amount of LINK to request                             |

#### Returns

| Type              | Description                                                    |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Promise<string>` | Promise resolving to the transaction hash of the fund transfer |

### routeMessage

Routes a sent message on the destination (connected) network, as the destination OffRamp would execute it.

```javascript
async function routeMessage(connection, routerAddresses, sent, options = {}) => Promise<Object>
```

> **NOTE**
>
> - pre-1.6 and 1.6: impersonates the lane's OffRamp and calls `executeSingleMessage`. - CCIP 2.0: the OffRamp selects
>   the CCVs (`getCCVsForMessage`), CCVs that are owner-configurable verifier resolvers are pointed at a synthetic no-op
>   verifier, and the raw encoded message is executed through the permissionless `execute`. A message is only delivered if
>   the OffRamp reports `SUCCESS`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                 | Description                                                                                                                         |
| --------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| connection      | `object`             | Network connection of the destination chain                                                                                         |
| routerAddresses | `string \| string[]` | Destination router address(es) whose OffRamps are searched, e.g. the default router and `CCIP_V2_ROUTERS[chainId]`                  |
| sent            | `CCIPSentMessage`    | A message returned by `getCCIPMessages`                                                                                             |
| options         | `Object`             | Optional: `forceExecution` (default `false`) executes CCIP 2.0 messages whose executor is `NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS` (manual execution) |

#### Returns

| Type     | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Object` | `{ offRamp, executed, reason }`: `executed` is `false` only for a CCIP 2.0 `NO_EXECUTION` message routed without `forceExecution` (`reason` is then `"NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS"`) |

> **CAUTION**
>
> **Possible Errors**
>
> - Throws if no OffRamp serves the lane (no OffRamp found for the message's source chain and OnRamp on the given routers)
> - Throws if execution fails (receiver revert, finality or CCV rejection)

---

## CCIPLocalSimulatorFork

A contract that simulates CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol) message routing in a Foundry test environment, for every CCIP era: pre-1.6 (`EVM2EVMOnRamp`), 1.6 and CCIP 2.0 (CCV-based lanes, which live testnet lanes run today).

[`CCIPLocalSimulatorFork`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/ccip/CCIPLocalSimulatorFork.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract provides utilities for testing cross-chain message routing by simulating message sending and receiving between different blockchain networks in a Foundry test environment. Works with Foundry only. Fork tests need `evm_version = "cancun"` or later (deployed CCIP 2.0 contracts use Cancun opcodes) and Foundry >= 1.5.1.

## Enums

### CCIPEra

```solidity
enum CCIPEra { UNKNOWN, PRE_V1_DOT_6, V1_DOT_6, V2 }
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The CCIP protocol version of a lane, detected from the OnRamp's `typeAndVersion()`.

### V2VerificationMode

```solidity
enum V2VerificationMode { STRICT, HYBRID, SYNTHETIC_ONLY, OFFRAMP_DERIVED }
```

> **NOTE**
>
> How CCIP 2.0 messages are verified when routed. The default is `OFFRAMP_DERIVED`: the CCV selection is derived from
> the destination OffRamp's `getCCVsForMessage(encodedMessage)` and the raw encoded message is executed through the
> permissionless `execute` entrypoint, so routing does not depend on the local `MessageV1` codec. CCV attestations are
> simulated with a synthetic no-op verifier.

### V2ExecutionMode

```solidity
enum V2ExecutionMode { AUTO, RESPECT_NO_EXEC, MANUAL_ONLY }
```

> **NOTE**
>
> How `NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS` (manual execution) messages are handled. The default is `RESPECT_NO_EXEC`: they are queued
> for `executePendingV2Message` instead of executed.

### MessageStatus

```solidity
enum MessageStatus { NOT_FOUND, QUEUED, FAILED, SUCCESS }
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Outcome of a captured CCIP message (see `getMessageStatus`). `NOT_FOUND`: never captured by this simulator. `QUEUED`:
> a CCIP 2.0 `NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS` message waiting for `executePendingV2Message`, or a 1.6 / 2.0 message whose
> destination fork was not passed to `switchChainAndRouteMessage` yet (a later call that includes it routes the
> message). `FAILED`: not routed, or execution did not succeed (the reason is recorded).

## Structs

### MessageOutcome

```solidity
struct MessageOutcome {
  MessageStatus status;
  bytes reason;
}
```

| Field  | Type            | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| status | `MessageStatus` | The outcome of the message                                                                                       |
| reason | `bytes`         | For `FAILED`: the revert data, or an `Error(string)` explaining why the message was not routed. Empty otherwise. |

## Errors

### CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageNotRouted

```solidity
error CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageNotRouted(bytes32 messageId, string reason)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Strict routing: a captured CCIP message was not routed to any destination fork.

### CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageExecutionFailed

```solidity
error CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageExecutionFailed(bytes32 messageId, bytes reason)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Strict routing: a routed message did not execute successfully. `reason` is the revert data of the execution (for CCIP
> 2.0, the OffRamp's recorded failure).

## Variables

### i_register

```solidity
Register immutable i_register
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The immutable Register contract instance used to store network configuration details. Placed with `vm.etch` rather
> than deployed, together with the `RegisterData` shards, so deploying the simulator does not cost the size of the
> Register code in gas.

### LINK_FAUCET

```solidity
address constant LINK_FAUCET = 0x4281eCF07378Ee595C564a59048801330f3084eE
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The address of the LINK token faucet contract, impersonated by `requestLinkFromFaucet`.

### s_processedMessages

```solidity
mapping(bytes32 messageId => bool isProcessed) internal s_processedMessages
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Internal mapping to track which messages have been processed to prevent duplicate processing.

### s_messageOutcomes

```solidity
mapping(bytes32 messageId => MessageOutcome outcome) internal s_messageOutcomes
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Outcome of every captured message, read with `getMessageStatus`.

### s_strictRouting

```solidity
bool internal s_strictRouting
```

> **NOTE**
>
> When true (the default), routing reverts on a message that is not routed or does not execute successfully. Toggle with
> `setStrictRouting`.

### s_ccipV2Routers

```solidity
mapping(uint256 chainId => address router) internal s_ccipV2Routers
```

> **NOTE**
>
> CCIP 2.0 routers deployed next to the Register router (which `getNetworkDetails` returns). Hand-maintained: `Register`
> is generated from the CCIP docs API and only carries one router per chain. Read and override with
> `getCCIPV2RouterAddress` / `setCCIPV2RouterAddress`.

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract and sets up logging and persistence.

```solidity
constructor()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Initializes the contract by:
>
> - Starting log recording (`vm.recordLogs`)
> - Placing the Register and its `RegisterData` shards with `vm.etch` at deterministic addresses, and making them persistent
> - Setting the default `V2VerificationMode` to `OFFRAMP_DERIVED`, strict routing to enabled, and `V2ExecutionMode` to `RESPECT_NO_EXEC`
> - Pre-registering the verified CCIP 2.0 routers for Ethereum Sepolia (`0x784d49a71BB4C48eB7dA4cD7e6Ecb424f9b5EAB1`) and Avalanche Fuji (`0x7C9B8B4e8024e5Ee8A630F6FCe9015e470dA5763`)

### switchChainAndRouteMessage

Routes a cross-chain message on the destination network after switching to the specified fork.

```solidity
function switchChainAndRouteMessage(uint256 forkId) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> To be called after sending a cross-chain message (`ccipSend`). The function:
>
> - Searches past logs for the supported CCIP send events (all eras)
> - Switches to the destination network fork
> - Routes the sent message on the destination network
> - If you sent more than one message, it tries to route all of them to `forkId`. A 1.6 or 2.0 message to another chain is kept (status `QUEUED`) and routed by a later call that includes its destination fork.
>
> `forkId` is the active fork when the call returns.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                                                                 |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| forkId    | `uint256` | The ID of the destination network fork (returned by `createFork()` or `createSelectFork()`) |

> **CAUTION**
>
> **Possible Reverts**
>
> With strict routing enabled (the default), reverts with `CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageNotRouted(messageId, reason)` when a captured message cannot be routed to any of the given forks, and with `CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageExecutionFailed(messageId, reason)` when a routed message does not execute successfully. Call `setStrictRouting(false)` to record failures instead and read them with `getMessageStatus`.

### switchChainAndRouteMessage (multiple forks)

Override variant of `switchChainAndRouteMessage(uint256 forkId)` for multiple destination forks.

```solidity
function switchChainAndRouteMessage(uint256[] memory forkIds) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Goes through the provided `forkIds` and routes messages to the matching destination. A 1.6 or 2.0 message to a chain
> that is not in `forkIds` is kept (status `QUEUED`) for a later call. With several destinations, either pass every
> destination fork at once with this overload, or call `switchChainAndRouteMessage` once per destination fork.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type        | Description                              |
| --------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| forkIds   | `uint256[]` | The IDs of the destination network forks |

### getNetworkDetails

Returns the network configuration details for a specified chain ID.

```solidity
function getNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId) external view returns (Register.NetworkDetails memory)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns the default values for currently CCIP supported networks. If a network is not present or values have changed,
> new network details can be added using `setNetworkDetails`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                                           |
| --------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| chainId   | `uint256` | The blockchain network chain ID (e.g., 11155111 for Ethereum Sepolia) |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type             | Description                                               |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| (unnamed) | `NetworkDetails` | The network configuration details for the specified chain |

### setNetworkDetails

Updates or adds new network configuration details for a specified chain ID.

```solidity
function setNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId, Register.NetworkDetails memory networkDetails) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Used to add or update network details when they are not present or have changed from default values.
> `getNetworkDetails` returns an all-zero struct for a chain ID that is not in `Register`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                                           |
| -------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| chainId        | `uint256`        | The blockchain network chain ID (e.g., 11155111 for Ethereum Sepolia) |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | The network configuration details to be stored                        |

### getCCIPV2RouterAddress

Returns the CCIP 2.0 router for a chain, or `address(0)` if none is known.

```solidity
function getCCIPV2RouterAddress(uint256 chainId) external view returns (address)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns the CCIP 2.0 router deployed next to the Register router on `chainId`, or `address(0)` if none is known. Send
> through this router (and point receivers at it) to use its CCIP 2.0 lanes; messages sent through either router are
> routed by `switchChainAndRouteMessage`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                     |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------- |
| chainId   | `uint256` | The blockchain network chain ID |

### setCCIPV2RouterAddress

Manually sets the CCIP 2.0 router for a chain.

```solidity
function setCCIPV2RouterAddress(uint256 chainId, address router) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Use `address(0)` to route through the Register router only.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                        |
| --------- | --------- | ---------------------------------- |
| chainId   | `uint256` | The blockchain network chain ID    |
| router    | `address` | The CCIP 2.0 router address to set |

### getOffRampForLane

Returns the destination OffRamp configured for a source OnRamp on the given fork.

```solidity
function getOffRampForLane(uint256 forkId, uint64 sourceChainSelector, address sourceOnRamp) external returns (address offRamp)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Useful to configure CCIP 2.0 lane CCVs (see `setLaneDefaultCCVs`) before routing a message. Returns `address(0)` when
> not found.

#### Parameters

| Parameter           | Type      | Description                                   |
| ------------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| forkId              | `uint256` | The ID of the destination network fork        |
| sourceChainSelector | `uint64`  | The chain selector of the source chain        |
| sourceOnRamp        | `address` | The address of the OnRamp on the source chain |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                                  |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| offRamp   | `address` | The matching OffRamp address, or `address(0)` when not found |

### setLaneDefaultCCVs

Points a destination lane's default CCVs at a CCV address by impersonating the OffRamp owner.

```solidity
function setLaneDefaultCCVs(uint256 forkId, address offRamp, uint64 sourceChainSelector, address ccv) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Fork-only testing helper for CCIP 2.0 lanes: the mocked CCV must be configured on the destination lane before a
> captured message can be routed through the permissionless execution path. Router, enabled flag, OnRamp bindings and
> lane-mandated CCVs are preserved, so the fork lane is never less strict than production.

#### Parameters

| Parameter           | Type      | Description                                        |
| ------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| forkId              | `uint256` | The ID of the destination network fork             |
| offRamp             | `address` | The destination OffRamp that holds the lane config |
| sourceChainSelector | `uint64`  | The chain selector of the source chain             |
| ccv                 | `address` | The CCV address to set as the lane default         |

### requestLinkFromFaucet

Requests LINK tokens from the faucet for a specified address.

```solidity
function requestLinkFromFaucet(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool success)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Transfers the specified amount of LINK tokens from the faucet (impersonated) to the provided destination address, on
> the active fork.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                            |
| --------- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| to        | `address` | The address to receive the LINK tokens |
| amount    | `uint256` | The amount of LINK tokens to transfer  |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type   | Description                                       |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------- |
| success   | `bool` | Returns true if the token transfer was successful |

### setStrictRouting

Enables or disables strict routing (enabled by default).

```solidity
function setStrictRouting(bool strict) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> When enabled, `switchChainAndRouteMessage` and `executePendingV2Message` revert with
> `CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageNotRouted` when a captured CCIP message cannot be routed to any of the given forks,
> and with `CCIPLocalSimulatorFork__MessageExecutionFailed` when a routed message does not execute successfully. When
> disabled, failures are logged and recorded (see `getMessageStatus`) and routing continues.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Description                                                |
| --------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| strict    | `bool` | Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) strict routing |

### getStrictRouting

Returns whether strict routing is enabled.

```solidity
function getStrictRouting() external view returns (bool strict)
```

### getMessageStatus

Returns the outcome of a captured CCIP message.

```solidity
function getMessageStatus(bytes32 messageId) external view returns (MessageStatus status, bytes memory reason)
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------- |
| messageId | `bytes32` | The CCIP message ID |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type            | Description                                                                                                                       |
| --------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| status    | `MessageStatus` | `NOT_FOUND`, `QUEUED`, `FAILED` or `SUCCESS`                                                                                      |
| reason    | `bytes`         | For `FAILED`: the revert data of the execution, or an `Error(string)` explaining why the message was not routed. Empty otherwise. |

### setV2VerificationMode

Sets how CCIP 2.0 messages are verified when routed.

```solidity
function setV2VerificationMode(V2VerificationMode mode) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The default is `OFFRAMP_DERIVED`. See the `V2VerificationMode` enum for the available modes.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                 | Description                  |
| --------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| mode      | `V2VerificationMode` | The verification mode to set |

### getV2VerificationMode

Returns the current CCIP 2.0 verification mode.

```solidity
function getV2VerificationMode() external view returns (V2VerificationMode mode)
```

### setV2ExecutionMode

Sets how `NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS` (manual execution) CCIP 2.0 messages are handled.

```solidity
function setV2ExecutionMode(V2ExecutionMode mode) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The default is `RESPECT_NO_EXEC`: such messages are queued for `executePendingV2Message` instead of executed.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type              | Description               |
| --------- | ----------------- | ------------------------- |
| mode      | `V2ExecutionMode` | The execution mode to set |

### getV2ExecutionMode

Returns the current CCIP 2.0 execution mode.

```solidity
function getV2ExecutionMode() external view returns (V2ExecutionMode mode)
```

### getPendingV2MessageIds

Returns the message IDs of pending CCIP 2.0 `NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS` messages on the current route scope.

```solidity
function getPendingV2MessageIds() external view returns (bytes32[] memory messageIds)
```

### isPendingV2Message

Checks whether a CCIP 2.0 message is pending manual execution.

```solidity
function isPendingV2Message(bytes32 messageId) external view returns (bool isPending)
```

### executePendingV2Message

Executes a pending CCIP 2.0 `NO_EXECUTION_ADDRESS` message on the current fork.

```solidity
function executePendingV2Message(bytes32 messageId) external returns (bool attempted)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Routes the pending message through the destination OffRamp's permissionless `execute` entrypoint. Returns `false` (and
> records a `FAILED` outcome) when no OffRamp on the current fork serves the message's lane. The message is dequeued
> once processed.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                    |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------ |
| messageId | `bytes32` | The CCIP message ID to execute |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type   | Description                                            |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| attempted | `bool` | Whether an execution was attempted on the current fork |

# CCIPLocalSimulator v0.3.1 API Reference
Source: https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-simulator

> **NOTE: Integrate Chainlink Local into your project**
>
> ### npm
>
> If you use [NPM](https://www.npmjs.com/), install the [@chainlink/local NPM
> package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/local):
>
> ```shell
> npm install @chainlink/local@0.3.1
> ```
>
> ### yarn
>
> If you use [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/), install the [@chainlink/local NPM
> package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/local):
>
> ```shell
> yarn add @chainlink/local@0.3.1
> ```
>
> ### foundry
>
> If you use [Foundry](https://book.getfoundry.sh/):
>
> ```shell
> forge install smartcontractkit/chainlink-local@v0.3.1
> ```
>
> and then set remappings to: `@chainlink/local/=lib/chainlink-local/` in either `remappings.txt` or `foundry.toml` file
>
> ### RemixIDE
>
> Import the `CCIPLocalSimulator` contract from the `@chainlink/local` package:
>
> ```solidity
> import {CCIPLocalSimulator} from "@chainlink/local@0.3.1/src/ccip/CCIPLocalSimulator.sol";
> ```

## CCIPLocalSimulator

A contract that simulates local CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol) operations for testing and development purposes.

[`CCIPLocalSimulator`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/ccip/CCIPLocalSimulator.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract deploys the pre-funded tokens, the
> [`CCIPLocalRouter`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-router) and the CCIP-BnM / CCIP-LnM test tokens,
> and includes methods to manage supported tokens and configurations for local simulations. Messages are delivered
> synchronously inside `ccipSend`, applying the CCIP 2.0 OnRamp and OffRamp message rules. See [CCIP 2.0 behavior in
> local mode](/chainlink-local/learn/ccip-v2-local) for what is and is not enforced.

## Functions

### configuration

Returns the configuration details for pre-deployed contracts and services needed for local CCIP simulations.

```solidity
function configuration() public view returns (uint64 chainSelector_, IRouterClient sourceRouter_, IRouterClient destinationRouter_, WETH9 wrappedNative_, LinkToken linkToken_, BurnMintERC677Helper ccipBnM_, BurnMintERC677Helper ccipLnM_)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns configuration details for pre-deployed contracts and services needed for local CCIP simulations.

#### Returns

| Parameter           | Type                   | Description                                              |
| ------------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| chainSelector_     | `uint64`               | The unique CCIP Chain Selector                           |
| sourceRouter_      | `IRouterClient`        | The source chain Router contract                         |
| destinationRouter_ | `IRouterClient`        | The destination chain Router contract                    |
| wrappedNative_     | `WETH9`                | The wrapped native token which can be used for CCIP fees |
| linkToken_         | `LinkToken`            | The LINK token                                           |
| ccipBnM_           | `BurnMintERC677Helper` | The ccipBnM token                                        |
| ccipLnM_           | `BurnMintERC677Helper` | The ccipLnM token                                        |

### supportNewTokenViaAccessControlDefaultAdmin

Adds a new token to supported tokens list via AccessControl's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

```solidity
function supportNewTokenViaAccessControlDefaultAdmin(address tokenAddress) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Allows user to support any new token, besides CCIP BnM and CCIP LnM, for cross-chain transfers. The caller must have
> the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as defined by the contract itself.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| tokenAddress | `address` | The address of the token to add to the list of supported tokens |

> **CAUTION**
>
> **Possible Reverts**
>
> - Reverts if the caller is not the admin of the token using OZ's AccessControl DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE

### supportNewTokenViaGetCCIPAdmin

Adds a new token to supported tokens list via CCIP admin role.

```solidity
function supportNewTokenViaGetCCIPAdmin(address tokenAddress) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Allows user to support any new token, besides CCIP BnM and CCIP LnM, for cross-chain transfers.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| tokenAddress | `address` | The address of the token to add to the list of supported tokens |

> **CAUTION**
>
> **Possible Reverts**
>
> - Reverts if token does not implement getCCIPAdmin() function
> - Reverts if the caller is not the token CCIPAdmin

### supportNewTokenViaOwner

Adds a new token to supported tokens list via token owner.

```solidity
function supportNewTokenViaOwner(address tokenAddress) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Allows user to support any new token, besides CCIP BnM and CCIP LnM, for cross-chain transfers.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| tokenAddress | `address` | The address of the token to add to the list of supported tokens |

> **CAUTION**
>
> **Possible Reverts**
>
> - Reverts if token does not implement owner() function
> - Reverts if the caller is not the token owner

Source: https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/data-streams-local-simulator-fork

> **NOTE: Integrate Chainlink Local into your project**
>
> ### npm
>
> If you use [NPM](https://www.npmjs.com/), install the [@chainlink/local NPM
> package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/local):
>
> ```shell
> npm install @chainlink/local@0.3.1
> ```
>
> ### yarn
>
> If you use [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/), install the [@chainlink/local NPM
> package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/local):
>
> ```shell
> yarn add @chainlink/local@0.3.1
> ```
>
> ### foundry
>
> If you use [Foundry](https://book.getfoundry.sh/):
>
> ```shell
> forge install smartcontractkit/chainlink-local@v0.3.1
> ```
>
> and then set remappings to: `@chainlink/local/=lib/chainlink-local/` in either `remappings.txt` or `foundry.toml` file
>
> ### RemixIDE
>
> Import the `CCIPLocalSimulator` contract from the `@chainlink/local` package:
>
> ```solidity
> import {CCIPLocalSimulator} from "@chainlink/local@0.3.1/src/ccip/CCIPLocalSimulator.sol";
> ```

## DataStreamsLocalSimulatorFork

A contract that simulates Data Streams operations on forked networks in a Foundry test environment.

[`DataStreamsLocalSimulatorFork`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/DataStreamsLocalSimulatorFork.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> Works with Foundry only. Use this simulator when your consumer contract needs the real `VerifierProxy` deployed on a
> live network; use [`DataStreamsLocalSimulator`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/data-streams-local-simulator)
> for local mode.

## Variables

### i_register

```solidity
Register immutable i_register
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The immutable Register contract instance used to store Data Streams network configuration details.

### LINK_FAUCET

```solidity
address constant LINK_FAUCET = 0x4281eCF07378Ee595C564a59048801330f3084eE
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The address of the LINK token faucet contract, impersonated by `requestLinkFromFaucet`.

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract.

```solidity
constructor()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Deploys the Data Streams `Register` with the built-in network details.

### getNetworkDetails

Returns the default values for currently Data Streams supported networks.

```solidity
function getNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId) external view returns (Register.NetworkDetails memory)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> If a network is not present or some of the values have changed, add new network details with `setNetworkDetails`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                                         |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| chainId   | `uint256` | The blockchain network chain ID (e.g., 421614 for Arbitrum Sepolia) |

#### Returns

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                                      |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | `verifierProxyAddress` and `linkAddress` for the specified chain |

### setNetworkDetails

Sets the network details for a given chain ID.

```solidity
function setNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId, Register.NetworkDetails memory networkDetails) external
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                           |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| chainId        | `uint256`        | The blockchain network chain ID                       |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | The network details to set for the specified chain ID |

### requestLinkFromFaucet

Requests LINK tokens from the faucet.

```solidity
function requestLinkFromFaucet(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool success)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Impersonates the LINK faucet and transfers LINK (at the address from the current chain's network details) to the
> destination address, on the active fork.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                            |
| --------- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| to        | `address` | The address to receive the LINK tokens |
| amount    | `uint256` | The amount of LINK tokens to transfer  |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type   | Description                                       |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------- |
| success   | `bool` | Returns true if the token transfer was successful |

### requestNativeFromFaucet

Requests native coins from the faucet.

```solidity
function requestNativeFromFaucet(address to, uint256 amount) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Deals the amount of native coins to the destination address with `vm.deal`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                             |
| --------- | --------- | --------------------------------------- |
| to        | `address` | The address to receive the native coins |
| amount    | `uint256` | The amount of native coins to send      |

## DataStreamsLocalSimulator

A contract that simulates local Data Streams operations for testing and development purposes.

[`DataStreamsLocalSimulator`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/DataStreamsLocalSimulator.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract deploys the mock verifier, verifier proxy, fee manager and reward manager, plus the LINK and wrapped
> native tokens, and lets you switch between on-chain and off-chain billing mechanisms. Reports are generated with
> [`MockReportGenerator`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-report-generator) and verified through the
> [`MockVerifierProxy`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-verifier-proxy).

## Variables

### feeManagerEnabled

```solidity
bool public feeManagerEnabled
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Whether the on-chain billing mechanism (fee manager) is enabled. On-chain billing is enabled by default.

## Functions

### configuration

Returns the configuration details for pre-deployed contracts and services needed for local Data Streams simulations.

```solidity
function configuration() public view returns (WETH9 wrappedNative_, LinkToken linkToken_, MockVerifier mockVerifier_, MockVerifierProxy mockVerifierProxy_, MockFeeManager mockFeeManager_, MockRewardManager mockRewardManager_)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The returned fee manager reflects the current billing state: it is the fee manager currently set on the verifier
> proxy, and the reward manager is `address(0)` when off-chain billing is enabled.

#### Returns

| Parameter           | Type                | Description                                                                 |
| ------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| wrappedNative_     | `WETH9`             | The wrapped native token                                                    |
| linkToken_         | `LinkToken`         | The LINK token                                                              |
| mockVerifier_      | `MockVerifier`      | The mock verifier contract                                                  |
| mockVerifierProxy_ | `MockVerifierProxy` | The mock verifier proxy contract                                            |
| mockFeeManager_    | `MockFeeManager`    | The mock fee manager contract (what is currently set on the verifier proxy) |
| mockRewardManager_ | `MockRewardManager` | The mock reward manager contract (`address(0)` if fee manager is disabled)  |

### constructor

Initializes the contract with pre-deployed instances.

```solidity
constructor()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Deploys WETH9, LinkToken, the mock verifier proxy and mock verifier, and (by default) the fee manager and reward
> manager for on-chain billing.

### enableOffChainBilling

Enables the off-chain billing mechanism by removing the fee manager.

```solidity
function enableOffChainBilling() external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Simulates chains that don't have FeeManager contracts deployed. After this call, `verify` and `verifyBulk` expect an
> empty `parameterPayload`.

### enableOnChainBilling

Enables the on-chain billing mechanism by deploying/setting the fee manager.

```solidity
function enableOnChainBilling() external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Simulates chains that have FeeManager contracts deployed. After this call, `verify` and `verifyBulk` expect a fee
> token address in `parameterPayload`.

### getBillingMechanism

Returns the current billing mechanism type.

```solidity
function getBillingMechanism() external view returns (string memory billingType)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns `"on-chain"` if the fee manager is enabled, `"off-chain"` if disabled.

### requestLinkFromFaucet

Requests LINK tokens from the faucet.

```solidity
function requestLinkFromFaucet(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool success)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The provided amount of tokens is transferred to the provided destination address.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                     |
| --------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| to        | `address` | The address to which LINK tokens are to be sent |
| amount    | `uint256` | The amount of LINK tokens to send               |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type   | Description                                             |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| success   | `bool` | Returns `true` if the transfer of tokens was successful |

## Register (Data Streams)

A contract that stores and retrieves Data Streams network details for various chains.

[`Register`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/Register.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract is separate from the CCIP [`Register`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/register): it stores the
> Data Streams verifier proxy and LINK addresses per chain. Used by
> [`DataStreamsLocalSimulatorFork`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/data-streams-local-simulator-fork).

## Structs

### NetworkDetails

Contains Data Streams configuration details for a specific network/chain.

| Field                | Type      | Description                                |
| -------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| verifierProxyAddress | `address` | The address of the Verifier Proxy contract |
| linkAddress          | `address` | The address of the LINK token contract     |

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract with predefined network details.

```solidity
constructor()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Built-in details cover Arbitrum Sepolia, Avalanche Fuji, Base Sepolia, opBNB Testnet and Soneium Minato Testnet.

### getNetworkDetails

Retrieves network details for a given chain ID.

```solidity
function getNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId) external view returns (NetworkDetails memory networkDetails)
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| chainId   | `uint256` | The ID of the chain to get the details for |

#### Returns

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                    |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | The network details for the specified chain ID |

### setNetworkDetails

Sets the network details for a given chain ID.

```solidity
function setNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId, NetworkDetails memory networkDetails) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Used to add or update network details when they are not present or have changed from default values.

#### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                           |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| chainId        | `uint256`        | The ID of the chain to set the details for            |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | The network details to set for the specified chain ID |

# Chainlink Local v0.3.1 API Reference
Source: https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1

> **NOTE: Integrate Chainlink Local into your project**
>
> ### npm
>
> If you use [NPM](https://www.npmjs.com/), install the [@chainlink/local NPM
> package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/local):
>
> ```shell
> npm install @chainlink/local@0.3.1
> ```
>
> ### yarn
>
> If you use [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/), install the [@chainlink/local NPM
> package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chainlink/local):
>
> ```shell
> yarn add @chainlink/local@0.3.1
> ```
>
> ### foundry
>
> If you use [Foundry](https://book.getfoundry.sh/):
>
> ```shell
> forge install smartcontractkit/chainlink-local@v0.3.1
> ```
>
> and then set remappings to: `@chainlink/local/=lib/chainlink-local/` in either `remappings.txt` or `foundry.toml` file
>
> ### RemixIDE
>
> Import the `CCIPLocalSimulator` contract from the `@chainlink/local` package:
>
> ```solidity
> import {CCIPLocalSimulator} from "@chainlink/local@0.3.1/src/ccip/CCIPLocalSimulator.sol";
> ```

Chainlink Local v0.3.1 (V3) targets CCIP 2.0: it pins `@chainlink/contracts-ccip` 2.0.0 and `@chainlink/contracts` 1.5.0, and the local router applies the CCIP 2.0 OnRamp and OffRamp message rules. Fork routing supports every CCIP era (pre-1.6, 1.6 and CCIP 2.0). Hardhat 2 is not supported in `0.3.x`; Hardhat 2 users stay on `0.2.x` (see [the release notes](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/CHANGELOG.md)).

## CCIP

These contracts provide Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) functionality in a local testing environment:

- [CCIPLocalSimulator](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-simulator) - Local CCIP simulator (no-fork mode)
- [CCIPLocalRouter](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-router) - The local-mode router with CCIP 2.0 message rules
- [CCIPLocalSimulatorFork](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-simulator-fork) - CCIP simulator for forked networks (all CCIP eras)
- [CCIPLocalSimulatorFork JS](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/ccip-local-simulator-fork-js) - Hardhat 3 JavaScript helpers for fork routing
- [Register](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/register) - CCIP network configuration registry

## Data Streams

Contracts for simulating Chainlink Data Streams:

- [DataStreamsLocalSimulator](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/data-streams-local-simulator) - Local Data Streams simulator (no-fork mode)
- [DataStreamsLocalSimulatorFork](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/data-streams-local-simulator-fork) - Data Streams simulator for forked networks
- [MockVerifier](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-verifier) - Mock Data Streams verifier
- [MockVerifierProxy](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-verifier-proxy) - Mock Data Streams verifier proxy
- [MockReportGenerator](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-report-generator) - Signed report generator for every report schema
- [MockFeeManager](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-fee-manager) - Mock verifier fee manager
- [MockRewardManager](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-reward-manager) - Mock reward manager
- [ReportVersions](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/report-versions) - Data Streams report schemas (`ReportV1`-`ReportV13`)
- [Register (Data Streams)](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/data-streams-register) - Data Streams network configuration registry

## Data Feeds

Contracts for simulating Chainlink Data Feeds:

- [AggregatorInterface](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/aggregator-interface) - Basic price feed interface
- [AggregatorV2V3Interface](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/aggregator-v2-v3-interface) - Combined V2/V3 price feed interface
- [AggregatorV3Interface](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/aggregator-v3-interface) - Extended price feed interface
- [MockOffchainAggregator](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-offchain-aggregator) - Mock implementation of off-chain aggregator
- [MockV3Aggregator](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-v3-aggregator) - Mock implementation of V3 aggregator

## Token Contracts

Standard token implementations for testing:

- [BurnMintERC677Helper](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/burn-mint-erc677-helper) - Helper contract for ERC677 token operations
- [LinkToken](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/link-token) - LINK token implementation
- [WETH9](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/weth9) - Wrapped Ether implementation

## LinkToken

A contract that implements the ChainLink Token (LINK) using the ERC677 standard.

[`LinkToken`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/shared/LinkToken.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract inherits from ERC677 token contract and initializes with a fixed total supply and standard token
> details.

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract with fixed token details.

```solidity
constructor()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Constructor to initialize the LinkToken contract with a fixed total supply, name, and symbol. Calls the ERC677
> constructor with the name "ChainLink Token" and symbol "LINK", then mints the total supply (10^27 tokens) to the
> contract deployer.

### _onCreate

Internal hook called during contract creation.

```solidity
function _onCreate() internal virtual
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Hook that is called when this contract is created. Useful to override constructor behaviour in child contracts (e.g.,
> LINK bridge tokens). The default implementation mints 10^27 tokens to the contract deployer.

## MockFeeManager

A mock implementation of the Data Streams verifier fee manager for local testing.

[`MockFeeManager`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/MockFeeManager.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract processes report verification fees in LINK or native token, applies per-subscriber discounts and a
> native surcharge, and forwards LINK rewards to the
> [`MockRewardManager`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-reward-manager). Only the verifier proxy may call its
> functions.

## Errors

### Unauthorized

```solidity
error Unauthorized()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when called by anyone other than the verifier proxy.

### InvalidAddress

```solidity
error InvalidAddress()
```

### InvalidQuote

```solidity
error InvalidQuote()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when the quote token is neither the LINK nor the wrapped native token.

### ExpiredReport

```solidity
error ExpiredReport()
```

### InvalidDiscount

```solidity
error InvalidDiscount()
```

### InvalidSurcharge

```solidity
error InvalidSurcharge()
```

### InvalidDeposit

```solidity
error InvalidDeposit()
```

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract.

```solidity
constructor(address linkAddress, address nativeAddress, address proxyAddress, address rewardManager)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Approves the reward manager to pull the LINK it receives.

#### Parameters

| Parameter     | Type      | Description                              |
| ------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| linkAddress   | `address` | The LINK token address                   |
| nativeAddress | `address` | The wrapped native token address         |
| proxyAddress  | `address` | The verifier proxy address (only caller) |
| rewardManager | `address` | The reward manager address               |

### processFee

Processes the fee for a single report verification.

```solidity
function processFee(bytes calldata payload, bytes calldata parameterPayload, address subscriber) external payable override onlyProxy
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Decodes the fee from the report, applies the subscriber discount and (for native quotes) the surcharge, then pulls the
> fee from the subscriber and forwards the LINK reward to the reward manager.

### processFeeBulk

Processes fees for multiple report verifications.

```solidity
function processFeeBulk(bytes[] calldata payloads, bytes calldata parameterPayload, address subscriber) external payable override onlyProxy
```

### getFeeAndReward

Returns the fee and reward for a report and quote token.

```solidity
function getFeeAndReward(address subscriber, bytes memory report, address quoteAddress) public view returns (Common.Asset memory, Common.Asset memory, uint256)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts with `ExpiredReport` when the report's `expiresAt` is in the past.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Description                                      |
| ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| subscriber   | `address` | The subscriber address (for the discount lookup) |
| report       | `bytes`   | The report data                                  |
| quoteAddress | `address` | The fee token to quote (LINK or wrapped native)  |

#### Returns

| Parameter | Type           | Description                               |
| --------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| (unnamed) | `Common.Asset` | The fee asset and amount                  |
| (unnamed) | `Common.Asset` | The reward asset and amount (always LINK) |
| (unnamed) | `uint256`      | The discount applied                      |

### setNativeSurcharge

Sets the surcharge applied to native token fees.

```solidity
function setNativeSurcharge(uint256 surcharge) external onlyOwner
```

### setMockDiscount

Sets a per-subscriber discount.

```solidity
function setMockDiscount(address subscriber, uint256 discount) external onlyOwner
```

> **NOTE**
>
> `1e18` is a 100% discount.

### withdrawMockFee

Withdraws accumulated fees.

```solidity
function withdrawMockFee(address to, address coin) external onlyOwner
```

### withdrawLink

Withdraws accumulated LINK.

```solidity
function withdrawLink(address to) external onlyOwner
```

>
> ### RemixIDE
>
> Import the `CCIPLocalSimulator` contract from the `@chainlink/local` package:

> ```solidity
> import {CCIPLocalSimulator} from "@chainlink/local@0.3.1/src/ccip/CCIPLocalSimulator.sol";
> ```

## MockOffchainAggregator

> **NOTE**

```solidity
    )

```

> **NOTE**
>

| Parameter   | Type     | Description            |
| ----------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| _minAnswer | `int192` | The new minimum answer |
| _maxAnswer | `int192` | The new maximum answer |

#### Possible Reverts

- Reverts if minAnswer is not less than maxAnswer with "minAnswer must be less than maxAnswer"
- Reverts if minAnswer is too low with "minAnswer is too low"
- Reverts if maxAnswer is too high with "maxAnswer is too high"

## MockReportGenerator

A contract that generates signed Data Streams reports for local testing.

[`MockReportGenerator`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/MockReportGenerator.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract generates reports for every report schema (`ReportV1` through `ReportV13`), signs them with a generated
> mock DON key, and returns the ABI-encoded signed report that a consumer passes to
> [`MockVerifierProxy.verify`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-verifier-proxy#verify). The report contents
> (price, bid/ask, fees, expiry, market status) are set with the `update*` functions.

## Errors

### MockReportGenerator__InvalidBid

```solidity
error MockReportGenerator__InvalidBid()
```

### MockReportGenerator__InvalidAsk

```solidity
error MockReportGenerator__InvalidAsk()
```

### MockReportGenerator__CastOverflow

```solidity
error MockReportGenerator__CastOverflow()
```

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the generator with an initial price.

```solidity
constructor(int192 initialPrice)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Sets the price, bid and ask to `initialPrice`, the expiry period to 1 day, and the market status to `2` (Open). The
> DON address and key are generated with `makeAddrAndKey("Mock Data Streams DON")`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type     | Description              |
| ------------ | -------- | ------------------------ |
| initialPrice | `int192` | The initial report price |

### generateReportV1..V13

Generates a signed report for a specific schema version.

```solidity
function generateReportV3() external returns (bytes memory signedReport, ReportV3 memory report)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> One `generateReportVn()` function exists per schema version (`generateReportV1` through `generateReportV13`),
> returning the signed report and the decoded report struct. Each version uses its own mock feed ID (for example
> `0x00037777…` for V3). Overloads that take a calldata report struct (`generateReport(ReportV3 calldata report)`) are
> also available.

#### Returns

| Parameter    | Type       | Description                   |
| ------------ | ---------- | ----------------------------- |
| signedReport | `bytes`    | The ABI-encoded signed report |
| report       | `ReportVn` | The generated report struct   |

### updatePrice

Updates the price used in generated reports.

```solidity
function updatePrice(int192 price) public
```

### updatePriceBidAndAsk

Updates the price, bid and ask used in generated reports.

```solidity
function updatePriceBidAndAsk(int192 price, int192 bid, int192 ask) external
```

### updateExpiresPeriod

Updates the report expiry period.

```solidity
function updateExpiresPeriod(uint32 period) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The report `expiresAt` is `block.timestamp + period` at generation time.

### updateMarketStatus

Updates the market status used in generated reports.

```solidity
function updateMarketStatus(uint32 status) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> `0` (Unknown), `1` (Closed) or `2` (Open).

### updateFees

Updates the native and LINK fees carried in generated reports.

```solidity
function updateFees(uint192 nativeFee, uint192 linkFee) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Both default to 0. The fees are charged by the
> [`MockFeeManager`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-fee-manager) when on-chain billing is enabled.

## MockRewardManager

A mock implementation of the Data Streams reward manager for local testing.

[`MockRewardManager`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/MockRewardManager.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract receives the LINK rewards collected by the
> [`MockFeeManager`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-fee-manager). Only the fee manager may call `onFeePaid`.

## Errors

### Unauthorized

```solidity
error Unauthorized()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when `onFeePaid` is called by anyone other than the fee manager.

## Events

### FeePaid

```solidity
event FeePaid(IRewardManager.FeePayment[] payments, address payer)
```

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract with the LINK token address.

```solidity
constructor(address linkAddress)
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type      | Description            |
| ----------- | --------- | ---------------------- |
| linkAddress | `address` | The LINK token address |

### onFeePaid

Records a fee payment and pulls the LINK from the payer.

```solidity
function onFeePaid(FeePayment[] calldata payments, address payer) external override onlyFeeManager
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Tallies the total payable fees and transfers the LINK from the payer to this contract.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type           | Description                                |
| --------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| payments  | `FeePayment[]` | The fee payments (pool ID and amount each) |
| payer     | `address`      | The address that paid the fees             |

### claimRewards

Not implemented.

```solidity
function claimRewards(bytes32[] memory) external pure override
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Always reverts with "Not implemented".

### setFeeManager

Sets the fee manager address.

```solidity
function setFeeManager(address newFeeManager) external override
```

### supportsInterface

```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure override returns (bool)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns true only for the `onFeePaid` selector.

## MockVerifierProxy

A mock implementation of the Data Streams verifier proxy for local testing.

[`MockVerifierProxy`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/MockVerifierProxy.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract forwards reports to the [`MockVerifier`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-verifier) and
> optionally bills the caller through a fee manager. It validates that the billing mechanism (on-chain or off-chain)
> matches what the consumer contract is using, with error messages that point to the fix.

## Errors

### ZeroAddress

```solidity
error ZeroAddress()
```

### VerifierInvalid

```solidity
error VerifierInvalid()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when the verifier does not support the `IVerifier.verify` interface.

### VerifierNotFound

```solidity
error VerifierNotFound()
```

### FeeManagerRequired

```solidity
error FeeManagerRequired(string message)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> On-chain billing is active but the consumer is using the off-chain mechanism: either call
> `simulator.enableOffChainBilling()` or provide the fee token address in `parameterPayload`.

### FeeManagerNotExpected

```solidity
error FeeManagerNotExpected(string message)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Off-chain billing is active but the consumer is providing `parameterPayload` for on-chain billing: either call
> `simulator.enableOnChainBilling()` or pass empty bytes as `parameterPayload`.

## Events

### VerifierInitialized

```solidity
event VerifierInitialized(address indexed verifierAddress)
```

## Functions

### verify

Verifies a report payload, billing the caller first when a fee manager is set.

```solidity
function verify(bytes calldata payload, bytes calldata parameterPayload) external payable returns (bytes memory)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> When a fee manager is set (on-chain billing), `parameterPayload` must carry the fee token address and `msg.value` the
> fee. With off-chain billing, pass empty bytes and no value.

#### Parameters

| Parameter        | Type    | Description                                                                              |
| ---------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| payload          | `bytes` | The signed report payload                                                                |
| parameterPayload | `bytes` | The fee payment parameters (fee token address for on-chain billing, empty for off-chain) |

### verifyBulk

Verifies multiple report payloads in one call.

```solidity
function verifyBulk(bytes[] calldata payloads, bytes calldata parameterPayload) external payable returns (bytes[] memory verifiedReports)
```

### initializeVerifier

Initializes the verifier address.

```solidity
function initializeVerifier(address verifierAddress) external onlyOwner
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The verifier must support the `IVerifier.verify` interface.

#### Parameters

| Parameter       | Type      | Description                          |
| --------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------ |
| verifierAddress | `address` | The address of the verifier contract |

### getVerifier

Returns the verifier address.

```solidity
function getVerifier(bytes32) external view returns (address)
```

### setFeeManager

Sets the fee manager.

```solidity
function setFeeManager(IVerifierFeeManager feeManager) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Pass `MockFeeManager(address(0))` to switch to off-chain billing.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                  | Description                     |
| ---------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| feeManager | `IVerifierFeeManager` | The fee manager contract to set |

## MockVerifier

A mock implementation of the Data Streams verifier for local testing.

[`MockVerifier`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/data-streams/MockVerifier.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract verifies reports signed by the mock DON address (generated from `keccak256("Mock Data Streams DON")`).
> Only the [`MockVerifierProxy`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-verifier-proxy) may call `verify`. Reports
> are generated with [`MockReportGenerator`](/chainlink-local/api-reference/v0.3.1/mock-report-generator).

## Errors

### AccessForbidden

```solidity
error AccessForbidden()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when `verify` is called by anyone other than the verifier proxy.

### InactiveFeed

```solidity
error InactiveFeed(bytes32 feedId)
```

### DigestInactive

```solidity
error DigestInactive(bytes32 feedId, bytes32 configDigest)
```

### BadVerification

```solidity
error BadVerification()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when the report signature does not recover to the mock DON address.

### InvalidV

```solidity
error InvalidV()
```

### AlreadyUsedSignature

```solidity
error AlreadyUsedSignature()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts on a replayed report signature.

### InvalidSignatureLength

```solidity
error InvalidSignatureLength()
```

### InvalidS

```solidity
error InvalidS()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Reverts when `s` exceeds half the secp256k1 curve order (EIP-2 signature malleability check).

## Events

### ReportVerified

```solidity
event ReportVerified(bytes32 indexed feedId, address indexed sender)
```

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract with the verifier proxy address.

```solidity
constructor(address verifierProxy)
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter     | Type      | Description                                |
| ------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| verifierProxy | `address` | The address of the verifier proxy contract |

### verify

Verifies a signed report and returns the report data.

```solidity
function verify(bytes calldata signedReport, address sender) external returns (bytes memory verifierResponse)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Only callable by the verifier proxy. Decodes the signed report, checks the feed and config digest are active, recovers
> the signer with `ecrecover` and marks the signature as used. Returns the report data.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Description                           |
| ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------- |
| signedReport | `bytes`   | The ABI-encoded signed report         |
| sender       | `address` | The address that submitted the report |

#### Returns

| Parameter        | Type    | Description             |
| ---------------- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| verifierResponse | `bytes` | The decoded report data |

### deactivateConfig

Deactivates a config digest for a feed.

```solidity
function deactivateConfig(bytes32 feedId, bytes32 configDigest) external
```

### activateConfig

Activates a config digest for a feed.

```solidity
function activateConfig(bytes32 feedId, bytes32 configDigest) external
```

### deactivateFeed

Deactivates a feed.

```solidity
function deactivateFeed(bytes32 feedId) external
```

### activateFeed

Activates a feed.

```solidity
function activateFeed(bytes32 feedId) external
```

### supportsInterface

```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure override returns (bool)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns true only for the `verify` selector.

## Register

A contract that stores and retrieves network details for various chains.

[`Register`](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local/blob/v0.3.1/src/ccip/Register.sol)

> **NOTE**
>
> This contract maintains a registry of network-specific details including chain selectors, router addresses, and token
> addresses for various supported networks. Built-in network details live in the generated data shards of
> `RegisterData.sol`, which the simulator places with `vm.etch`, instead of being written to storage in the constructor:
> storing \~150 chains cost \~24M gas, which made `CCIPLocalSimulatorFork` too expensive to deploy on 30M-gas-limit forks.
> Sharding keeps every generated contract runtime under the EIP-170 limit. `setNetworkDetails` overrides are stored.

## Structs

### NetworkDetails

Contains configuration details for a specific network/chain.

| Field                            | Type      | Description                                  |
| -------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| chainSelector                    | `uint64`  | Unique identifier for the chain in CCIP      |
| routerAddress                    | `address` | Address of the CCIP Router contract          |
| linkAddress                      | `address` | Address of the LINK token contract           |
| wrappedNativeAddress             | `address` | Address of the wrapped native token contract |
| ccipBnMAddress                   | `address` | Address of the CCIP BnM token contract       |
| ccipLnMAddress                   | `address` | Address of the CCIP LnM token contract       |
| rmnProxyAddress                  | `address` | Address of the RMN proxy contract            |
| registryModuleOwnerCustomAddress | `address` | Address of the registry module owner         |
| tokenAdminRegistryAddress        | `address` | Address of the token admin registry contract |

## Variables

### s_networkDetails

```solidity
mapping(uint256 chainId => NetworkDetails) internal s_networkDetails
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Internal mapping that stores network details set with `setNetworkDetails`, overriding the built-in ones.

### s_isOverridden

```solidity
mapping(uint256 chainId => bool isOverridden) internal s_isOverridden
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Internal mapping that records whether `setNetworkDetails` was called for a chain ID.

## Functions

### constructor

Initializes the contract.

```solidity
constructor()
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Built-in network details are not stored here; they live in the generated `RegisterData` shards. A bare `new
>   Register()` only serves `setNetworkDetails` overrides.

### getNetworkDetails

Retrieves network details for a given chain ID.

```solidity
function getNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId) external view returns (NetworkDetails memory networkDetails)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Returns the `setNetworkDetails` override for the chain ID when one was set, otherwise the built-in details from the
> data shards. An unknown chain returns an all-zero struct.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                                |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| chainId   | `uint256` | The ID of the chain to get the details for |

#### Returns

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                    |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | The network details for the specified chain ID |

### setNetworkDetails

Sets the network details for a given chain ID.

```solidity
function setNetworkDetails(uint256 chainId, NetworkDetails memory networkDetails) external
```

> **NOTE**
>
> Used to add or update network details when they are not present or have changed from default values.
> `getNetworkDetails` returns an all-zero struct for a chain ID that is not in `Register`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type             | Description                                           |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| chainId        | `uint256`        | The ID of the chain to set the details for            |
| networkDetails | `NetworkDetails` | The network details to set for the specified chain ID |

### shardAddress

Returns the deterministic address of built-in data shard `index`.

```solidity
function shardAddress(uint256 index) public view returns (address)
```

> **NOTE**
>
> The simulator places each generated `RegisterDataN` shard at this address with `vm.etch`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                               |
| --------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| index     | `uint256` | The shard index (0 to `_SHARD_COUNT - 1`) |
